subject: 30-day evaluation — success metrics & ops runbook
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@oryxhealth.com>, Samir Shah <samir.shah@oryxhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery — Evaluation next steps (30-day plan)

Hi Elena & Samir,

Thanks again for the great conversation today. Quick recap + proposed plan so we have a single place to iterate: 

High-level goal (30-day evaluation): confirm whether Redwood Inference reduces inference latency for your triage model by >=40% at 95th pct while preserving result fidelity (measured with the eval rubric I attached). Success = latency target met AND no more than 2% drop in top-1 accuracy on the test set.

Proposed milestones & owners (draft):
- Kickoff (week 0): environment access + sample data delivered by Oryx — target Jun 6 — Owner: Elena/Samir
- Baseline run (week 1): run current infra to capture latency/throughput — Owner: Oryx engineering
- Redwood integration (week 1–2): deploy model variant on Redwood sandbox; KV/prefix caching configured — Owner: Neha (SE)
- Run comparisons (week 2–3): run eval matrix, gather token-level cost and latency — Owner: Jordan/Marissa
- Readout & decision (week 4): final results + next-step recommendation — Owner: joint (Redwood + Oryx)

Operational asks for kickoff:
1) A sample of the production query set (anonymized) and the ground-truth labels for the eval matrix.
2) A short list of the 3 priority endpoints/flows we should optimize for.
3) Sandbox IAM/credentials with limited dataset access or an S3 presigned bucket.

Attached: SOW draft (SOW_Redwood_Oryx_20270607.pdf), evaluation matrix template (eval_matrix_oryx.xlsx), and a lightweight runbook skeleton (runbook_skeleton.md).

Proposed kickoff dates: Jun 8 or Jun 9 (30–45 minute sync + brief ops run). Let me know which works.

Risks called out: SOC2 evidence request may slow data transfer; if Oryx cannot share labeled data, we'll rely on synthetic holdout and extend the timeline by one week.

Next steps: please confirm the success criteria above, the preferred kickoff date, and who will own data delivery.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@oryxhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Shah <samir.shah@oryxhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery — Evaluation next steps (30-day plan)

Jordan — thanks for the concise plan. This aligns well. A couple of edits/notes: 

Success criteria: we agree with the latency goal but would prefer a slightly tighter fidelity tolerance: max 1.5% drop in top-1. Can Redwood flag individual requests that change classification to help our SREs triage?

Data delivery: we'll deliver an anonymized sample + labels by EOD Jun 6. I'll own that and Samir will coordinate access. We can provide an S3 presigned URL (preferred).

Kickoff: Jun 8 works for us (10:00–10:45 PT). If anything changes, will ping here.

Stakeholders to include on readout:
- Elena Ruiz — Head of ML Ops (executive sponsor)
- Samir Shah — Engineering lead (primary contact)
- Priyanka Mehta — Head of Product (may join final readout)

On the SOC2 note, we will start an internal request so that only the minimum set of artifacts are shared.

Thanks — looking forward to the test.
Elena
Elena Ruiz | Head of ML Ops
Oryx Health
elena@oryxhealth.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Oryx 30d eval — owners, quick ops notes

Marissa / Neha — forwarding the proposed plan from the call (see below). Key asks for the internal playbook: 

Immediate items:
- Neha: prepare sandbox image with the quantized variant we discussed (4-bit profile) and a pre-configured KV cache layer. Aim to have this ready by EOD Jun 7 so we can validate on Jun 8 kickoff.
- Marissa: please reserve a dedicated sandbox GPU slot and add monitoring hooks to the console dashboard (token-level cost, 95th pct latency) so we have visibility from day 1.
- Jordan: I'll coordinate the evaluation matrix and the readout agenda; I'll own the final customer-facing deck.

Potential blockers / mitigations:
- Data access delay — ask Elena for S3 presigned link; if delayed, run on synthetic holdout and flag as "data-limited" in readout.
- Compliance artifacts — Marissa, please pull the SOC2 checklist we use for ephemeral demos and confirm minimal required items.

I'll draft the kickoff agenda (15 min ops, 20 min technical, 10 min Q&A) and circulate by EOD Jun 6.

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 14:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Oryx 30d eval — owners, quick ops notes

Quick technical checklist for kickoff and first week (for ops runbook):

1) Sandbox image: base model + 4-bit quantized variant (needing GPU: A10 / T4 class).
2) Inference config: max_tokens, batch_size profile (we'll tune after baseline).
3) KV cache + prefix cache enabled; ensure cache TTL is configurable.
4) Monitoring: custom metric for "classification drift" events (we'll instrument as a boolean flag when top-1 changes).
5) Data ingestion: provide S3 presigned URL to /oryx-eval/sample/ by Jun 6; we will pull and run ingestion job.

Attachment: runbook_skeleton.md (contains step-by-step commands and log locations). Please confirm credentials flow (IAM vs presigned URL) — presigned is simpler for a short eval.

If we get the dataset by EOD Jun 6 I can stand up the image and run a smoke test on Jun 8 morning.

-Neha
SE, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
